Children.Name: Access Control Assistance Operators
Children.Description: Members of this group can remotely query authorization attributes and permissions for resources on this computer.

Children.Name: Account Operators
Children.Description: Members can administer domain user and group accounts

Children.Name: Administrators
Children.Description: Administrators have complete and unrestricted access to the computer/domain

Children.Name: Backup Operators
Children.Description: Backup Operators can override security restrictions for the sole purpose of backing up or restoring files

Children.Name: Certificate Service DCOM Access
Children.Description: Members of this group are allowed to connect to Certification Authorities in the enterprise

Children.Name: Cryptographic Operators
Children.Description: Members are authorized to perform cryptographic operations.

Children.Name: Distributed COM Users
Children.Description: Members are allowed to launch, activate and use Distributed COM objects on this machine.

Children.Name: Event Log Readers
Children.Description: Members of this group can read event logs from local machine

Children.Name: Guests
Children.Description: Guests have the same access as members of the Users group by default, except for the Guest account which is further restricted

Children.Name: Hyper-V Administrators
Children.Description: Members of this group have complete and unrestricted access to all features of Hyper-V.

Children.Name: IIS_IUSRS
Children.Description: Built-in group used by Internet Information Services.

Children.Name: Incoming Forest Trust Builders
Children.Description: Members of this group can create incoming, one-way trusts to this forest

Children.Name: Network Configuration Operators
Children.Description: Members in this group can have some administrative privileges to manage configuration of networking features

Children.Name: OpenSSH Users
Children.Description: Members of this group may connect to this computer using SSH.

Children.Name: Performance Log Users
Children.Description: Members of this group may schedule logging of performance counters, enable trace providers, and collect event traces both locally and via remote access to this computer

Children.Name: Performance Monitor Users
Children.Description: Members of this group can access performance counter data locally and remotely

Children.Name: Pre-Windows 2000 Compatible Access
Children.Description: A backward compatibility group which allows read access on all users and groups in the domain

Children.Name: Print Operators
Children.Description: Members can administer printers installed on domain controllers

Children.Name: RDS Endpoint Servers
Children.Description: Servers in this group run virtual machines and host sessions where users RemoteApp programs and personal virtual desktops run. This group needs to be populated on servers running RD Connection Broker. RD Session Host servers and RD Virtualization Host servers used in the deployment need to be in this group.

Children.Name: RDS Management Servers
Children.Description: Servers in this group can perform routine administrative actions on servers running Remote Desktop Services. This group needs to be populated on all servers in a Remote Desktop Services deployment. The servers running the RDS Central Management service must be included in this group.

Children.Name: RDS Remote Access Servers
Children.Description: Servers in this group enable users of RemoteApp programs and personal virtual desktops access to these resources. In Internet-facing deployments, these servers are typically deployed in an edge network. This group needs to be populated on servers running RD Connection Broker. RD Gateway servers and RD Web Access servers used in the deployment need to be in this group.

Children.Name: Remote Desktop Users
Children.Description: Members in this group are granted the right to logon remotely

Children.Name: Remote Management Users
Children.Description: Members of this group can access WMI resources over management protocols (such as WS-Management via the Windows Remote Management service). This applies only to WMI namespaces that grant access to the user.

Children.Name: Replicator
Children.Description: Supports file replication in a domain

Children.Name: Server Operators
Children.Description: Members can administer domain servers

Children.Name: Storage Replica Administrators
Children.Description: Members of this group have complete and unrestricted access to all features of Storage Replica.

Children.Name: Terminal Server License Servers
Children.Description: Members of this group can update user accounts in Active Directory with information about license issuance, for the purpose of tracking and reporting TS Per User CAL usage

Children.Name: Users
Children.Description: Users are prevented from making accidental or intentional system-wide changes and can run most applications

Children.Name: Windows Authorization Access Group
Children.Description: Members of this group have access to the computed tokenGroupsGlobalAndUniversal attribute on User objects
